annotations.title: Look up a domain's Domain Rating

description: Look up a domain's Domain Rating (Ahrefs' 0–100 measure of its backlink profile) and its rank, from Ahrefs' free Domain Rating endpoint — credit it as "Domain Rating by Ahrefs" wherever you show it. Needs an agent token (connect an account first): each reading spends a shared daily budget. Cached; nothing else is read from the site.

domain.description: The domain to look up (example.com), or any URL on it.

name: check_domain_rating

credit.description: Show this credit with the number (Ahrefs' Domain Rating licence).

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.
